caption:
In 2010, Brazil made almost no wind power. By 2025 it was fourth in the world.

2015: into the top 10. 2016: China takes the lead. 2021: Brazil is 4th.

From 22 TWh in 2015 to 118 TWh in 2025. About 18% more every year, so it doubles every 4.1 years.

Growth that compounds looks slow, then sudden. Try it free: mba.rimilab.com (link in bio)
